title: Warning toasts in yellow, with buttons below the text
text: When you start a card that has to wait for another one, Seismic shows a warning that it is queued and hasn't started yet. That warning used to be a brownish box with its buttons squeezed in beside the text, so the text wrapped into a narrow column. Now it uses the same yellow as the other warnings in the app: the text runs across the full width, and 'Go to card' and 'Dismiss' sit below it.
chapters: Before: a brown box, buttons beside the text
After: yellow, text full width, buttons below
